Actions.use_case: Use to read the Azure Blob Storage Inventory policy on the customer storage account so the scaled backup pipeline can verify the daily inventory rule is configured.
Use to create or update the Azure Blob Storage Inventory rule that emits the daily blob manifest consumed by the scaled Azure Blob backup pipeline.
Use to delete the Azure Blob Storage Inventory rule on offboarding or when the scaled backup pipeline is disabled, so no stale inventory artifacts continue to be produced.
Use to create the destination container that receives the daily Azure Blob Storage Inventory parquet manifest written by the inventory rule.
Use to delete the inventory destination container on offboarding or when the scaled backup pipeline is disabled.

DataActions.use_case: Use to write blobs into the inventory destination container (e.g. Exocompute-driven scaled writes). Restricted to the 'rubrik-inventory' container.
Use to delete blobs from the inventory destination container during cleanup or offboarding. Restricted to the 'rubrik-inventory' container.
